body:
This Network360 release includes security fixes along with small enhancements for Create a List, and fixes within Accessibility, Provider List Details – Networks Specialty exports, Compare Networks, Competitive Dashboard, and Create a List. 

# Enhancements

### Create a List

Now, the Create a List .pdf export includes an Analysis Criteria page where all the analysis criteria will be listed instead of displaying an abbreviated list of the criteria on the export’s cover page. 

Updated the validation message for bulk entries of NPIs to enhance user’s understanding when NPIs that were entered do not exist within the project’s data. 



# Fixes

### Accessibility

Now on the Access Details by Zip Code exports, the average distance to 1st, 2nd, and 3rd provider is the distance to the 1st, 2nd, and 3rd unique provider.  In the past, these results displayed the distance to the 1st, 2nd, and 3rd provider location regardless of the uniqueness of the provider.  

The members count which displays on the Top Hospitals tab is now accurate when the analysis criteria includes attributes. 

Now, when the user selects multiple confidence levels, the criteria summary will correctly display the criteria with an “or” conjunction instead of an “and” conjunction.  In other words, it will now display “high or medium” when the user selects these two confidence levels as part of the criteria.

### Compare Networks

Now when the Comparison Network’s name is long, on the Network Strength results page the name will wrap within the criteria summary instead of overlapping with the legend.

### Competitive Dashboard

Now, the activity stream includes the user’s attribute selections when the user exports the Network Counts by Provider Type and the Network Counts by Specialty Group .csv reports. 

### Create a List

Now when the user’s analysis includes confirmed practicing providers, the number of offices in the Concise Office export matches the number of offices on the Summary Results page. 

Fixed an issue where the Provider list Details - Networks Specialty Details .csv export of providers in three specific networks in Montana took longer than expected to complete. 

Fixed an intermittent issue where zip codes (that were entered for a radius search) were not consistently utilized in the determination of the results nor displayed in the criteria summary.  Now, the selected the results and criteria summary correctly reflect the radius search of the selected zip codes.
shortDescription: This Network360 release includes security fixes along with small enhancements for Create a List, and fixes within Accessibility, Provider List Details – Networks Specialty exports, Compare Networks, Competitive Dashboard, and Create a List.
